newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising amid positive sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising amid positive sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may continue their rally on Tuesday helped by news of possible management changes in the exchange, brokers said.

"Both retail and institutional buying may push share prices up across the board. Confidence in the market has been boosted by the news that there may be changes in DSE council (management)," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed.

Brokers said some of the council members were allegedly involved in price manipulations that had caused upheavals in the market recently. The DSE index closed 65.16 points up at 1,102.37 on Monday. -- Dhaka Newsroom + 880-2-506363
